description: This file contains the PHP class 'SaleReturn' which is an extension controller for handling sale return reports within the OpenCart admin backend. The class manages rendering report forms, processing report data, saving settings, and generating report views and JSON responses.

classes.name: SaleReturn
classes.description: Controller class for handling sale return reports within the OpenCart admin extension system. Provides methods for displaying report forms, saving configurations, listing reports, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the sale return report form page, initializes page data, breadcrumbs, and loads necessary view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings. Checks permissions, saves configuration data, and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the sale return report, including filtering, pagination, and loading the report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and outputs the sale return report list as a view.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches report data based on filters such as date range, return status, and grouping, and returns report data as a string.
